corrections.text: The title and summary describe the pull request author as a maintainer. The cited pull request pages show GitHub's "Contributor" label and do not state the author's role; the project's MAINTAINERS.md file, which the article does not cite, lists Martin Atkins (@apparentlymart) as an Organization Maintainer.

The Advisory Index section says the August advisory has "a different release history" and that "None of the ten is dated October". The cited advisories page does not show release histories, and it lists one advisory (GHSA-wpr2-j6gr-pjw9) dated October 3, 2024; none of the ten is dated October 2026.
